svg.desc: 2022–2025 · wider corpus and two-topic output Source: OpenAlex core · https://api.openalex.org Retrieved: works 2026-11-06; author histories 2026-11-06. Observed through 2025-12-31. Method: atlas-primary-publications-v1. Two-topic cohort (P2): brain-computer interfaces and electroencephalography (EEG), and neural engineering (T10429 and T11601). Selected comparison baseline: General science. Gray band: four-domain growth range. 9 same-category comparisons available; 12 unavailable. Category-specific denominators are preserved. All-science context: +24.4% to +34.7% across life, social, physical and health sciences. Retrieved 2026-11-06T12:47:02.184070+00:00. Cohorts and units vary by group. All neurotech: +65.1%; wider-corpus (NT10) total growth, 2022–2025. Venue N = wider-corpus (NT10) indexed works; region/institution N = P2 two-topic whole-work involvement. D = all-field works in the same category. Unit: OpenAlex work ID; groups overlap. Method/BCI: wider-corpus indexed works. Career/citation: two-topic author-fractional works, scaled by quarterly known coverage. References unavailable for these groups.
